model_input: Existing sanitize_raw twelve fields; original session IDs and original inference sorting retained
model_parameters: Unchanged weights, feature extraction, boundary threshold, clustering distances and threshold selection
artifact_recovery: Only original bytes or JSON CRLF-to-LF bytes that exactly match the existing pinned SHA256; write a new staging directory and verify again
medoid_policy: Cosine medoid among observed workflows with at least one existing action(); lifecycle-only workflows remain in all analysis tables but are ineligible as representatives
capture_scope: One independently recorded capture, one declared root/target tab and one frame; concurrent tabs or frames fail closed
capture_binding: CSV SHA256, byte count, exact columns, event count, contiguous csv_row and CSV id, event/session/time/tab/frame identity must match the capture manifest
capture_order: Original worker archive ordinal (manifest csv_row), never timestamp sorting or global event_sequence sorting
sequence_scope: event_sequence is local to the original session; require positive unique increasing integers within each contiguous session block
session_transition: Same tab/frame/root; previous block ends with page_close and next block begins with collector_boot followed by page_view; original sessions are never rewritten
capture_procedures: Map all actionful source events through actual model process_steps, then preserve their archive order; compress only identical existing signatures adjacent in the actionful subsequence within the same source workflow/model/session; skipped lifecycle rows stay in lineage, as in the existing process_map compression policy
graph_identity: Preserve observed source node IDs, including revisits; procedure order identifies occurrences
branches: Unproven cross-context order, interleaved session blocks or inconsistent navigation evidence fails; never invent links or choose by correctness
scope_label: CAPTURE_OBSERVED_SEQUENCE is an observed execution view, not a learned process medoid or a guarantee of typical whole-business semantics
lifecycle_policy: Keep every original row and workflow; report action()-excluded rows separately without creating procedures
coverage_policy: Event preservation is diagnostic only and is not an official success criterion or M03 score
evaluation_policy: Never consume independent reference, GT, evaluation result or business labels as model features; missing reference remains NOT_READY with null score
